title: Arrays
description:
## Arrays
An array stores multiple values in one variable.
```ts
const videos: string[] = ["Cat Falls", "Dog Runs", "Bird Flies"];
console.log(videos[0]); // Cat Falls
console.log(videos[1]); // Dog Runs
console.log(videos.length); // 3
```
- `string[]` means an array of strings
- `[0]` accesses the first element (arrays start at 0)
- `.length` gives the number of elements

You can also modify arrays:
```ts
videos.push("Fish Swims");  // add to end
videos[0] = "Cat Jumps";    // change first element
```
